title: Low spell ranks far below your level get less spell power and fewer talent procs
claim: In the current beta build, spells cast with ranks far below your level get less benefit from spell damage/healing and a reduced chance to trigger class abilities and talents; Blizzard's example: Rank 1 Frostbolt at level 60 has a 0% chance to proc Frostbite.
detail: Shown in the character-sheet Spell Damage/Healing tooltips and quoted from developer notes. Also cited for Omen of Clarity and Mage Arcane Concentration (deep dive). The rank's own base damage/heal is not reduced. For leveling: cast your top damage rank; use rank 1 only for its effect (e.g. R1 Frostbolt slow), and don't expect R1 Blizzard/Wrath to fish for Clearcasting at high level. Proc-chance curve not published. Formula for the spell-power part: n:20261010-downrank-formula-5pct.

title: Downrank formula: a rank keeps full spell power for 17 levels after you learn it, then loses 5% per level
claim: Measured on the beta: a rank keeps share = 1 - (L - 17 - T) x 0.05 of its spell-power coefficient (clamped 0-1), where L is your level and T the level the rank is learned; e.g. Rejuvenation R1 (T=4): 95% at 22, 55% at 30, 0% at 41.
detail: Community measurement (Whiteleaf, DoubleZug, holypalaswe; DoubleZug video/spreadsheet Oct 3) on heals up to level 30; assumed but not verified for damage spells and above 30. Not official. Classic Era used a different penalty, so the coach should not apply Era downrank math. Up to ~30, cheaper heal ranks are still more mana-efficient (Healing Wave R3 ~30% more heal per mana than R5 at 200 healing power).

title: Priest Penance damage and healing cut; rank 1 costs 50% more mana
claim: Oct 8 build: Penance damage and healing reduced (it behaved like a 3 s channel instead of 2 s), Penance rank 1 mana cost +50%, healing raised on ranks 2 and 4; client data shows Penance rank 4 now hits for 92 vs 72 for rank 3.
detail: Discipline talent. Big forum backlash ('RIP Priests', 'Priests, Penance, and Why I Just Don't Care Anymore'): players report wand ticks rival a Penance tick at low level and Smite feels mana-heavy. For leveling Priests: Penance is no longer a core damage button early; wand + Shadow Word: Pain and Smite ranks smoothed by n:20261009-caster-rank-smoothing.

title: Low ranks of main nukes and heals retuned so every new rank is an upgrade
claim: Oct 8: base and per-level values of the low ranks of Wrath (1-5), Frostbolt (1-5), Fireball (1-5), Arcane Missiles (1-3), Smite (1-4), Lesser Heal (1-3)/Heal (1-2), Lightning Bolt (1-5) and Shadow Bolt (1-4) were adjusted so each new rank is always an upgrade; client data: Frostbolt R1 per-level gain 0.5 -> 0.2, Frostbolt R4 base 60 -> 70.
detail: Low-rank spells no longer scale up with your level as much, so training each new rank matters more while leveling. Client numbers from the wowsims-forever regeneration on build 70338 + Oct 10 hotfixes: Thorns 22 -> 18, Retribution Aura 30 -> 20, Penance R4 92 > R3 72. Also: Ret Aura and Thorns back to Vanilla (6% SP ratio), Penance cut (n:20261010-penance-nerf), Demoralizing Shout/Roar cause threat.

title: Hunter: Immolation and Explosive Trap will scale with attack/spell power from the Oct 15 build
claim: Immolation Trap and Explosive Trap currently ignore attack power and spell power; Blizzard designer Aidan Moon marked this fixed for the Oct 15 build, which also lets one Frost and one Fire trap be active at the same time.
detail: Until Oct 15 trap damage only changes with talents (Clever Traps, Improved Tracking). After the fix, trap-and-kite and Survival leveling get stronger with gear. Scaling ratio not published (SoD's T.N.T. was 25% of AP for reference).

title: Mage: AoE farming tools nerfed (Improved Blizzard slow 40%, shorter Cone of Cold)
claim: Mage deep dive: Improved Blizzard's slow is capped at 40% (was 65%), Cone of Cold's duration is reduced, and Arcane Concentration procs less from much lower ranks; Frostfire Bolt (3 s, Fire+Frost DoT and slow) is learned at 40 and Mage Armor gives more Spirit regen.
detail: Blizzard frames the Blizzard/Cone of Cold changes as anti-farming/boosting. Classic-style kite-AoE grinding (Blizzard + Frost Nova + Cone of Cold) is weaker: the 40% slow lets mobs reach you more often. Ice Lance (11-pt) is instant, +300% vs frozen. Players in 'Mages are screwed' also complain about mana costs and low-rank penalties (n:20261010-downranking-penalty).

title: Shaman: weapon imbues last 60 min and stack with stones; totems 1 s GCD, 5 min duration
claim: Shaman deep dive: Rockbiter/Flametongue/Frostbrand/Windfury Weapon last 60 minutes (was 5) and coexist with sharpening stones, weightstones and wizard oil; totem GCD is 1.0 s (was 1.5), persistent totems last 5 min (was 2), Totemic Recall (level 20) refunds 25% mana, Call of the Elements (20) drops a preset of 4 totems.
detail: Large leveling QoL: fewer recasts and less mana between pulls. Lightning Bolt ranks 4+ cast 2.5 s (was 3) and Chain Lightning 2 s (was 2.5), both with lower coefficients. Totemic Projection at 22, Call of the Spirits 30, Call of the Ancestors 40. Beta bug: Totemic Recall doesn't refund mana yet. Windfury/Flametongue Totem are party buffs that don't stack with your own imbue.

title: Warlock: pets scale with your stats, Life Tap scales with Spirit, Drain Soul shard chance rises per tick
claim: Warlock deep dive: demons scale from the Warlock's stats, Life Tap scales with Spirit, Drain Soul has a rising per-tick chance to give a Soul Shard (guaranteed eventually), and Firestone/Spellstone become weapon imbues that stack with other temporary enchants.
detail: Gear now makes the Voidwalker/Imp stronger while leveling. Demonic Knowledge (Demo row 5): spell damage up to 33% of your level while a demon is out. Fel Vitality: pet HP/mana and your mana +15%. Curse of Agony becomes a Bane (one Bane per target); Curse of Shadows removed. Oct 8: current pet is stunned while summoning a new one. Oct 15 fix pending: Soul Link castable below 30 via Talented gives no buff.

title: Rogue: Sap no longer breaks Stealth; poisons stack with sharpening stones
claim: Rogue deep dive: Sap no longer breaks Stealth, poisons have more charges and can be applied together with temporary weapon enchants (weightstones, sharpening stones), Feint's threat reduction is doubled and Rogues can use one-handed axes.
detail: Leveling: Sap-then-restealth pulls are possible, and poisons + stones stack for more damage per kill. Talents: Flawless Execution (16 pts) -10 Eviscerate energy, Hack and Slash replaces weapon specializations, Vigor is 2 points. No Rogue class changes in the Oct 8 notes.

title: Student Fodder no longer gives rested XP (it did in SoD)
claim: In Forever, Student Fodder from the Cozy Sleeping Bag chain no longer grants rested XP (in Season of Discovery one gave about 4 bars, ~20% of a level); it now restores health and resources and applies Trail Snack, +60% movement speed with a heal over time.
detail: Single blog source, no Blizzard post cited. Don't plan SoD-style Fodder stacking for rested. The sleeping bag itself still gives +1%/min up to +3% for 1 h (n:20261009-cozy-sleeping-bag). Trail Snack speed is useful for travel legs.

title: Camp Tent tops rested XP up to 5% of a level, once per hour
claim: Client data (build 70334): Camp Tent (spell 1307230) lets you and others sitting nearby raise Rested XP to 5% of a level, with no effect if you already have more; it needs a Campfire nearby, triggers after 30 s of resting (1229487), and Boosted Rest (1229451) blocks another tent gain for 1 h.
detail: So a tent is a small top-up (5% of a level per hour), not a big rested source; Well Rested (n:20261009-legacy-perk-numbers) raises rested gain and cap by 20%. All camp features share one cooldown (1308027). Read from the wowforever.one client-data SQLite; not confirmed in game.

title: Legacy perk values: Frequent Flier -50% cost/+20% flight speed, Field Guide -8% camp cooldown, Talented from level 9 down to 5, Well Rested +20%
claim: Per the beta client tree: Frequent Flier (1 rank) 50% flight-path discount and 20% faster flights; Field Guide (3 ranks) camp cooldown -8%; Talented (5 ranks) first talent point at level 9, down to 5 at 5 ranks; Well Rested rested XP accumulates 20% faster and rested cap +20% (client spell 1225478); Permanence (2 ranks) class buffs and camp rest +50% duration; Gourmand (3 ranks) food buff duration +33%.
detail: Well Rested now matches two sources (guide: +4% per rank x5; client spell text: 20% faster, cap +20%). Other values still single-source; Field Guide's client text is a formula (m1/-36000). The tree hides 2 more perks per tree in the beta. Daybreak Forever lists 24 Legacy perks in build 70291.

title: Datamined: Archmagister's Wisdom/Perception give +10% XP from Undead kills for 5 min
claim: Client data lists two Forever spells, Archmagister's Wisdom (1292997) and Archmagister's Perception (1293736): 'Increase experience gained from slaying Undead by 10% for 5 min.'
detail: Source item/NPC not identified; likely Dalaran/Kirin Tor content (Wowhead's data added 'Archmagister's Faceted Pendant', item 273049, on Oct 10). If obtainable while leveling, it stacks a +10% kill-XP window for undead-heavy areas (Tirisfal, Duskwood, Scarlet Monastery, Plaguelands). Unconfirmed in game.

title: Ships: Menethil - Southshore - Auberdine, and Stormwind Harbor - Auberdine
claim: Forever adds a ship from Menethil Harbor (Wetlands) to Auberdine (Darkshore) that stops at Southshore (Hillsbrad Foothills), and Stormwind Harbor is open with a ship to Auberdine.
detail: Blizzard's 'Your Adventure Begins' leveling video (Oct 9) shows the Wetlands-Darkshore route with a Hillsbrad stop and the open Stormwind Harbour; beta riders report Stormwind Harbor <-> Auberdine. No sailing times yet. Alliance routes per guides (faction access not tested). Changes Alliance travel: Stormwind -> Darkshore without Menethil, and Southshore reachable by sea.

sources.author: Wowhead (Three New Ship Routes Debuting in Forever)

title: Small beta client builds 70334 and 70338 on Oct 10; next real build Oct 15
claim: Beta client builds 1.60.1.70334 (~01:00 UTC Oct 10) and 1.60.1.70338 (~06:40 UTC) followed build 70291 with almost no data changes (70334: 9 rows, a Summon Azurky pet spell and 3 items; 70338: none in sim tables); hotfixes are delivered via DBCache.
detail: No Blizzard post about them (no blue posts Oct 9-10). The leveling build is still 70291 (Oct 8); Zirene keeps marking fixes for Oct 15.

title: Beta: Loch Modan/Badlands login hang was a server hiccup, resolved Oct 9
claim: Characters logged out in Loch Modan or Badlands hung on the loading screen after the Oct 8 build; Blizzard's Aidan Moon said it was a world server hiccup, and affected players confirmed they could log in again on Oct 9.

title: Blood Fury and Berserking may be nerfed; weapon-skill racials may change in next week's build
claim: Aggrend said on the WoW: Forever podcast that Orc Blood Fury and Troll Berserking are 'perhaps a little too strong' and may be nerfed, and that the weapon-skill/crit racials could be kept, replaced or removed, with changes expected in next week's beta build.
detail: No numbers. Could lower Orc/Troll burst on pulls while leveling. Shatter Curse and Rapid Regeneration were mentioned as possibly affected.

title: Name reservation reportedly opens Oct 27
claim: A fan tracker lists WoW Forever name reservation opening on October 27, 2026, before the November 4 launch.
detail: Single unofficial source; same site gives the beta end as Oct 21 while Blizzard's roadmap reads Sept 17 - Oct 22.
